name: fyp-monorepo
description: Full-stack FYP Starter: React + Node.js + FastAPI + PostgreSQL

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server-node && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "NODE,FASTAPI,CLIENT" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:node" "npm run dev:python" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:python: cd server-python && (if exist venv\Scripts\python.exe (venv\Scripts\python.exe run.py) else (python run.py))
